note: A repository's merge policy as read at sha, the base whose .mesh/config.yml the integrator last read (ADR 063): source file when it names merge_policy, else default. requiredKinds is the base set every pull request carries, in kind order, each {kind, because} with because default (the platform's rule) or policy; evaluator is always there. riskClasses are merge_policy.risk_classes by class name, each {class, adds}: what a change hitting the class adds. faults are what of merge_policy was left out. A repository with no policy, or never read (sha blank), answers source default with requiredKinds [evaluator, node_validation] because default and no riskClasses or faults.
